investigation_notes.Scriptblock: Get-ChildItem C:\Users -Recurse -Include *.kdbx,*.pst,*.docx -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object FullName,Length | Export-Csv C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv -NoTypeInformation
investigation_notes.Description: The PowerShell command recursively searches C:\Users for .kdbx, .pst, and .docx files and exports file names and sizes to C:\ProgramData\user_cache.csv. It was executed on FIN-SRV-01 by user m.laane (a non-service account) and targets high-value data types on a financial server, with no parent process or known administrative tool indicated in the alert. Given the selection of sensitive file types, export to a common system path, and interactive user execution on a sensitive host, this activity is classified as High Priority due to likely data collection or staging behavior consistent with unauthorized harvesting.
